title: NafisRecord
description: NAFIS (National Automated Fingerprint Identification System) table schema - NCRB nationwide 10-digit biometric linking and interstate crime records

national_fingerprint_number.description: Primary Key: Unique 10-digit National Fingerprint Number (NFN) managed by NCRB

state_afis_id.description: Foreign Key: Reference to state-level AFIS profile (e.g. AFIS-GJ-2026-004512)

interstate_crime_record.description: Multi-state criminal history and active warrants registered outside Gujarat

cross_jurisdiction_flag.description: True if subject is flagged for apprehension across multiple state police forces

federal_linking_status.description: Federal and inter-agency coordination status (e.g. NCRB Red Notice, CBI Alert, Active Interstate Warrant)
